name: OpenVoxel ModLoader (client)
summary: The loader itself: Minecraft-style UI, survival, crafting, skins, mods API.
author: OpenVoxel-ModLoader
readme:
# ModLoader client

Download `ModLoader-v1.0.0-vgame-0.0.8-client.jar`, put the repo folder next to the launcher and run `launch.bat` / `launch.sh`. In the launcher select **0.0.8-Debug**.

name: OpenVoxel ModLoader (server)
summary: Server core plugin: interactive console, colors, utility commands; runs the official dedicated server.
author: OpenVoxel-ModLoader
readme:
# ModLoader server

Download `ModLoader-v1.0.0-vgame-0.0.8-server.jar` into `dist/`, copy the official server jar to `server/openvoxel-server.jar` and run `start.bat` / `start.sh`.
